original.title: Unit transport delay does not imply pointwise sublinearity
original.statement: Bounded matching delay and O(n) signed inventory do not imply o(n) pointwise imbalance.
assumptions: Abstract signed event stream; this is explicitly not a canonical Chomp history.

exactAuditedStatement: There exists an abstract signed event stream with a capacity-one opposite-sign matching of delay exactly1 and signed crossing inventory O(n), but pointwise imbalance not o(n).
hypotheses: Abstract dated token stream only, not a canonical Chomp realization.
independentDerivationAndChecks: For each k>=1 put2k positive tokens at2k and2k negative tokens at2k+1, pairing equal local indices. Every token has one distinct partner one row away.
Every completed two-row pair contributes zero to the signed prefix. At cut2k the prefix and crossing stock are2k; at cut2k+1 they are0. Hence stock<=n, also o(n^2).

Pointwise imbalance is2k at2k and-2k at2k+1, so its absolute value divided by n tends to1 on both subsequences. This refutes exactly the claimed inference, without asserting any canonical counterexample.
